Let's Build A Chess Ontology #4

Released Oct 29, 2025, 29 min

Play Let's Build A Chess Ontology #4 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

I'm back at it! Took me a bit to get myself caught up, but in the end I get a semantics that I like decently well for :moveOrder to help relate us from an opening (e.g. :QueensGambit) and the move order (e.g. "1.d4 d5 ..." ). I also show how the chess ontology looks when it's connected to my upper ontology, which we view in Protege.

In the next video, we'll show how to take a chess opening structured data dataset and do some ETL to put it in the ontology/graph. Should be fun!
